Package org.apache.juneau.commons.secret

Class EnvVarSecretStore

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.secret.EnvVarSecretStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
SecretStore
public class EnvVarSecretStore extends Object implements SecretStore
A read-only SecretStore backed by System.getenv(String).

Gives 12-factor deployments a zero-dependency way to feed secrets in as environment variables: find(java.lang.String) and exists(java.lang.String) resolve straight from the process environment. Because the environment is immutable from within the process, the mutating operations are unsupported:

  • store(String, char[]) throws UnsupportedOperationException.
  • delete(String) throws UnsupportedOperationException.

Note that environment variables are inherently more exposed than a dedicated secret backend (they are visible to child processes and to anything that can read the process environment), so this store trades secrecy strength for deployment simplicity. The retrieved value is never toString()'d, logged, or dumped by this class.

Since:
10.0.0

      Description copied from interface: SecretStore
      Stores a secret under the specified key, replacing any existing value.
